request.query: Weighted order of product of multivariate formal power series over a semiring with no zero divisors equals sum of weighted orders.

items.informal_name: Additivity of Weighted Order under Multiplication of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g
items.informal_description: For a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ and multivariate power series $ f, g $, the weighted order of the product $ f \cdot g $ with respect to $ w $ is equal to the sum of the weighted orders of $ f $ and $ g $ with respect to $ w $. Formally, $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(fg) = \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) + \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(g) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of Product Equals Sum of Weighted Orders in Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_4} (w : σ → ℕ)
  (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f i)
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $ with no zero divisors and nontrivial, the weighted order of the product of a finite set of multivariate power series over $ R $ with respect to a weight function $ w $ is equal to the sum of the weighted orders of each individual power series. Formally, for any finite set $ s $, $ \text{weightedOrder}_w\left(\prod_{i \in s} f_i\right) = \sum_{i \in s} \text{weightedOrder}_w(f_i) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of Product of Multivariate Power Series Bounds Sum of Individual Weighted Orders
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_4} (w : σ → ℕ) (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R)
  (s : Finset ι), ∑ i ∈ s, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f i) ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of multivariate power series over a commutative semiring $ R $, indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the sum of the weighted orders of each series in $ s $ is less than or equal to the weighted order of their product. If the product is the zero series, its weighted order is $ \top $ (infinity).

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of Product is at Least Sum of Weighted Orders
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)
items.informal_description: For multivariate power series $ f $ and $ g $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of the product $ f \cdot g $ is at least the sum of the weighted orders of $ f $ and $ g $. Symbolically, $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) + \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(g) \leq \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f \cdot g) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of Product is Greater or Equal to Sum of Weighted Orders
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)
items.informal_description: For any multivariate power series $f$ and $g$ over a semiring $R$ with variables indexed by $\sigma$, and a weight function $w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N}$, the weighted order of the product $f \cdot g$ is greater than or equal to the sum of the weighted orders of $f$ and $g$. Symbolically, $\mathrm{ord}_w(f) + \mathrm{ord}_w(g) \leq \mathrm{ord}_w(fg)$, where $\mathrm{ord}_w(h)$ denotes the weighted order of a power series $h$.
